column1: # Lanjutan 13_skill_mech.tsv, tapi rentangnya penuh (0-130.000): berkas lama
# memakai #range 25000 125000 sehingga ~290 deskripsi skill ber-id di bawah
# 25.000 dan ratusan di atas 125.000 tidak pernah tersentuh.
# Nama jenis damage dibawa utuh lewat backref sebagai SUBJEK kalimat, jadi
# keluarannya "<color>Burn damage</color> yang diterima berkurang ..." dan bukan
^((?:<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)?[A-Za-z]+ damage(?:</color>)?) dealt by all allied units is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: \1 dari semua unit sekutu meningkat sebesar \2\3%</color>.

column1: ^When dealing ((?:<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)?[A-Za-z]+ damage(?:</color>)?), critical damage is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat memberikan \1, Critical Damage meningkat sebesar \2\3%</color>.

column1: ^Damage dealt to enemy targets on ([A-Za-z]+) tiles is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage ke target musuh di tile \1 meningkat sebesar \2\3%</color>.

column1: ^If this unit has a buff, damage dealt is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Jika unit ini memiliki buff, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^Damage taken by allied units is reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> and stability damage taken is reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) points?</color>\.$
column2: Damage yang diterima unit sekutu berkurang sebesar \1\2%</color> dan damage Stability yang diterima berkurang sebesar \3\4 poin</color>.

column1: ^Allied units' defense is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> and stability damage taken is reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) points?</color>\.$
column2: Defense unit sekutu meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color> dan damage Stability yang diterima berkurang sebesar \3\4 poin</color>.

column1: ^Damage taken by allied units is reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage yang diterima unit sekutu berkurang sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^When stability is greater than (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) points?</color>, damage taken by all ally units'? damage taken is reduced by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat Stability lebih dari \1\2 poin</color>, damage yang diterima semua unit sekutu berkurang sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^If an allied unit goes into Stability Break, the next active healing additionally restores (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) points?</color> of stability index\.$
column2: Jika unit sekutu masuk Stability Break, healing aktif berikutnya memulihkan tambahan \1\2 poin</color> Stability Index.

column1: ^If an attack exploits a weakness, it ignores (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> of the target's defense\.$
column2: Jika serangan mengeksploitasi kelemahan, serangan itu mengabaikan \1\2%</color> Defense target.
